title: Debug the shipping tiers
prompt: This classifier has a logic bug: some orders get the wrong tier. Trace each price point, find the flawed branch, and fix the minimum amount of code. Rules: 100+ → "free", 50–99.99 → "5.00", below 50 → "8.00".

tests.name: all tiers correct
tests.hint: The second if must be else-if, or 100+ orders fall through to it.
